summary: Thinking indicator with a pixel wave and a rolling seconds counter; when finished it reads "Thought for Ns" and expands to show the reasoning.

props.name: done
props.description: Whether thinking has finished (controlled). Use with `onDoneChange`. When it turns true, the glyph draws a check, the label rolls to "Thought for Ns" and the reasoning becomes expandable. Turning it false returns to thinking; the counter keeps running from the last start.

props.name: defaultDone
props.description: Whether it starts finished, when uncontrolled. A component that starts done reads "Thought for 1s".

props.name: onDoneChange
props.description: Called when `finish()` or `restart()` changes the state.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called when the state changes to done, with the whole seconds elapsed (at least 1). Not called when the component mounts already done.

props.name: children
props.description: The reasoning, shown in a collapsible panel once done.

props.name: labels
props.description: The visible copy, for translation: `thinking` (the label while working), `done(seconds)` (the label once done) and `counter(seconds)` (the running counter). Missing entries use the English defaults "Thinking", "Thought for Ns" and "Ns".

methods.description: Resets the counter to 0 and returns to the thinking state, collapsing the reasoning.

keyboard.action: On the label, once done: show or hide the reasoning.

accessibility: The label is a native `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at the reasoning panel. It is disabled while thinking and enabled once done; activating it shows or hides the reasoning.
The collapsed reasoning is `inert`, so it is neither read nor reachable with Tab until it opens.
The check icon and the pixel-wave canvas are `aria-hidden`.
There is no live region, so the counter and the finished label are not announced.
motion: With reduced motion the pixel wave holds at a fixed brightness, the label shimmer stops, and the label and counter swap text without rolling.
notes: Seconds count from mount, or from `restart()`. The counter runs on a timer, so it stays correct while the component is off screen; the wave pauses there.
The labels default to English; pass `labels` to translate them.

props.children: Effort levels change how long the model reasons. Ultracode also lets the model plan multi-agent workflows on its own.
